name: briefing_action_fade_in_element_tick
description: HudUiBriefingAction_FadeObjectiveNoise::Tick advances objective picture noise alpha by a fixed 0.5 step and completes at alpha >= 1.0.
known_limits: Focused VC5 COFF byte comparison is clean under briefing_text_block_order_current_shape; owner tier S remains deferred to the complete Briefing source-owner because 0x403930 remains byte-blocked.
The prior smoke described action-vtable/table-slot assertions and must be refreshed before this target is reused as current tier evidence.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x404740 validates alpha += 0.5, storing alpha to HudUiBriefingObjectivePicture::noiseAlpha, invalidating the target, returning 0 while alpha < 1.0 and 1 when alpha >= 1.0. Slot offsets are ABI evidence only.

The native smoke validates alpha/noiseAlpha 0.5 with return 0, then alpha/noiseAlpha 1.0 with return 1 and two invalidates; action-table invocation assertions are stale after the source-model cleanup.
